scope: Prerequisite review of the next 20 unreviewed anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins originals in cohort order
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references and scripts were not read or executed. Findings concern the original bodies only; missing adapters are prerequisite gaps, not exclusions or observed failures.

sources.workflow: Track candidates from sourcing through acceptance and calculate stage and hiring metrics.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Candidate stages and dates; an ATS connection for automatic retrieval and updates.
sources.offline_assessment: Stages and metrics can be drafted from supplied data. Real-time status updates require an ATS adapter and access.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare calculations with candidate records and, for live claims, inspect ATS state and update evidence.

sources.workflow: Synthesize research into evidenced themes, segments, opportunities and recommendations.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Research inputs such as transcripts, surveys or feedback; optional feedback, analytics and knowledge-base connections.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied research can support a local synthesis. Connector-based enrichment, validation and publication require corresponding services.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace quotes, participant counts and recommendations to supplied data; verify any claimed publication or analytics against the service.

sources.workflow: Review a complete contract against a playbook or disclosed generic baseline, classify deviations, propose redlines and negotiation priorities.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Contract and deal context; organizational playbook or explicit generic-review fallback. Qualified legal review is required before reliance.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft analysis is possible from locally supplied materials. Remote document retrieval and optional contract-management routing need service access; legal adequacy requires human review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare clauses and redlines against the contract and applicable playbook, and obtain qualified counsel's review and any actual routing evidence.

sources.workflow: Aggregate customer sentiment, draft review replies, identify quiet customers and prepare win-back messages and a report.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviews or exports, relevant customer and order history, confirmed owner voice and authorized offers; owner approval before each post or message.
sources.offline_assessment: A partial report and drafts can use supplied exports. Live gathering, posting, messaging and connected artifact delivery need adapters and actual approval.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check source coverage, quote fidelity, churn calculations, authorized offers, individual approvals and any claimed posts or sends.

sources.workflow: Identify operational risks, score likelihood and impact, and prepare a prioritized mitigation register.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A project, vendor, process or decision context and evidence sufficient to assess risks, owners and mitigations.
sources.offline_assessment: The matrix and a provisional register can be prepared from supplied context; actual risk ownership and mitigation status require confirmation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check scoring against the matrix and validate risk evidence, assigned owners and mitigation status with responsible stakeholders.

sources.workflow: Create or revise a roadmap, prioritize initiatives, expose capacity tradeoffs and dependencies, and communicate changes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current roadmap or user description, requested operation, initiative details and relevant estimates, dependencies and capacity.
sources.offline_assessment: A proposed roadmap and prioritization can be prepared from supplied inputs. Pulling current tracker data or updating tickets requires a connected tracker.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check calculations and before-and-after changes against inputs, validate capacity and dependencies with owners, and inspect any claimed tracker update.

sources.workflow: Document an operational procedure with prerequisites, exact steps, verification, troubleshooting, rollback and escalation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The procedure's actual access, tools, inputs, commands, expected outcomes and escalation details.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft is possible from supplied operational knowledge. Publication and incident linking require services; procedure correctness requires a representative test.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Have an unfamiliar operator follow the runbook in an appropriate environment and verify results, rollback and escalation paths.

sources.workflow: Guide a scientist through idea development, troubleshooting or strategic decisions using risk, parameter and decision-tree frameworks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A user's idea, problem or strategic question and follow-up context; detailed modules are in linked references.
sources.offline_assessment: Conversational planning is possible with supplied context. Literature validation requires actual evidence or search access; future scientific outcomes cannot be established by the planning draft.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Review the reasoning and cited literature against the project's evidence, and assess feasibility with qualified researchers.

sources.workflow: Select a single-cell model and prepare, train, embed and analyze appropriate omics data.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Appropriate dataset and metadata, raw integer counts, relevant batch information, software environment and workflow-specific scripts or references.
sources.offline_assessment: Model selection and an analysis plan can be drafted offline. Actual training and scientific results require compatible data, code and a suitable runtime.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect input counts and metadata, runtime and training records, model outputs and independent biological or integration validation.

sources.workflow: Parse a query, search connected sources in parallel, rank and deduplicate results, and provide an attributed synthesis.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A query and at least one connected searchable source for the live search.
sources.offline_assessment: Query decomposition and ranking can be rehearsed on supplied results. Actual cross-source search requires adapters, accessible sources and live responses.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect source calls, filters, returned records, attribution, deduplication and reported failures.

sources.workflow: Classify queries, generate source-specific variants, rank evidence and broaden or report gaps when searches fail.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A question, source capabilities and results for the selected search scope.
sources.offline_assessment: Decomposition, translation and ranking can be tested on supplied fixtures. Parallel live retrieval and rate-limit handling require real source adapters and responses.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify query translations, ranking against returned evidence, fallback behavior and actual parallel source activity.

sources.workflow: Check a final document, configure signers and order, and route it for signature or prepare manual instructions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Final agreed document with exhibits, correct entities and authorized signers, required approvals and counsel review, plus signing and recipient details.
sources.offline_assessment: Checklist and manual instructions can be drafted from supplied information. Sending an envelope and obtaining signatures require the service and real participants.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check final documents, signer authority, approvals and counsel review; inspect the actual envelope and execution records before claiming completion.

sources.workflow: Calculate single-cell QC metrics, apply configurable outlier and gene filters, and produce annotated data and plots.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A supported single-cell data file, appropriate dependencies and scripts, and dataset-specific thresholds and gene patterns.
sources.offline_assessment: A QC plan can be drafted without execution. Actual filtered datasets and plots require the runtime, scripts and input data; biological interpretation requires review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect inputs, parameters, logs, cell and gene counts, before-and-after plots and biological appropriateness.

sources.workflow: Maintain a content calendar, confirm owner voice, produce and repurpose designs and copy, and stage rather than publish.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Confirmed voice, calendar and source assets; approval of calendar, generation budget, selected designs and copy. Connected design and staging paths need their services.
sources.offline_assessment: Calendar, copy and asset briefs can be drafted from supplied materials. Generated designs, durable staging and service-backed calendar updates require adapters and observed results.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check owner approvals, product facts, each design and queue state; verify email rows remain text-only and nothing was published.

sources.workflow: Detect connected search sources, guide source setup, prioritize sources by query type and report health or rate limits.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An available tool inventory; source configuration and authentication for any newly connected service.
sources.offline_assessment: Priority and guidance can be described from a supplied inventory. Actual availability, authentication and rate limits require runtime and service evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare reported capabilities with the runtime inventory and inspect connection and rate-limit responses for any live claims.

sources.workflow: Identify controls, select samples, prepare workpapers and evaluate documented exceptions and deficiencies.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Control area and period, control matrix, complete population, risk and prior-result information, and supporting control evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: Templates and sample selection can be prepared from supplied data. Actual control conclusions require underlying evidence and qualified financial review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify population completeness, sampling method and selections, inspect control evidence and obtain qualified review of conclusions.

sources.workflow: Write, translate and troubleshoot analytical SQL using dialect-specific functions and common query patterns.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The target dialect, schema, analytical question and relevant data or representative fixtures.
sources.offline_assessment: SQL drafts and static reasoning are possible offline. Correctness, performance and cost claims require execution or plans on the target engine and data.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate dialect syntax and semantics against the schema, compare results with known cases and inspect target-engine plans and performance.

sources.workflow: Orient a biological researcher, inspect available servers and skills, mention optional setup and ask what assistance is needed.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Runtime tool inventory and the researcher's stated interests; optional server installation is separate.
sources.offline_assessment: The welcome and skill overview can be presented offline. Connection status must come from the actual runtime; optional installations cannot be assumed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the reported server and skill inventory with the actual environment and confirm any claimed setup independently.

sources.workflow: Produce a stakeholder status report covering metrics, accomplishments, risks, decisions and next priorities.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reporting period and project or team information, including metrics, status, risks and decisions.
sources.offline_assessment: A report can be drafted from supplied evidence. Automatic retrieval and posting require connected services and actual activity.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile metrics, owners, dates and decisions with source records and verify any claimed publication.

sources.workflow: Gather and code research, identify and triangulate themes, rank findings, develop evidence-based segments and recommend opportunities.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Research sources, participant context, research question and decisions to inform; sizing needs supporting quantitative data.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthesis can be produced from supplied research. Connected-source retrieval and quantitative validation require actual data and adapters; unsupported estimates remain uncertain.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace findings, quotes, counts, contradictions and opportunity estimates to source data, and assess confidence and sampling limitations.

source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
